title: Discovery & Spatial Inquiry
subtitle: Listening, Site Context & Intent
description: We begin with rigorous dialogues regarding your lifestyle rituals, aesthetic ambitions, and budget parameters. Concurrently, we conduct solar studies, wind analyses, and topographic surveys to uncover the innate poetry of the site.

title: Conceptual Blueprint & Massing
subtitle: Spatial Flow & Volumetric Sculpting
description: We translate spatial narratives into volumetric models, hand sketches, and functional circulation plans. We explore how light enters at different hours, refining proportions until the architectural form achieves effortless balance.

title: Materiality & Detail Engineering
subtitle: Tactile Palettes & Technical Precision
description: Every junction, reveal, and joinery interface is engineered to millimeter tolerances. We build physical material boards—sourcing local stone, hand-finished metals, and bespoke timbers—ensuring structural integrity and sensory depth.

title: Artisanal Realization & Handover
subtitle: Rigorous Site Supervision & Art Curation
description: Our senior architects oversee on-site construction alongside master craftsmen. We manage milestone inspections, quality control, lighting calibration, and custom art installation right up to the white-glove handover.
